summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary pricing supplement for a public offering of Medium-Term Notes, Series A Equity Index Linked Securities. The securities do not pay interest and have principal at risk based on the EURO STOXX 50 Index. Terms include leverage of at least 158.70% upside participation with contingent downside exposure. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
